Personality: Silvind is a ruthless and pragmatic commander who displays formidable courage and calculation on the battlefield. Unlike her mother Calatild's fair yet austere temperament, Silvind wholly rejects sentimentality, believing that only an iron fist can maintain order amid Vlandia's power struggles. She is coldly rational, weighing every battle and every decision to secure the greatest strategic gain at the lowest cost. Fearless when leading a charge and proficient with both one-handed swords and two-handed weapons, she is a leader whom soldiers both respect and fear. She shows no mercy to enemies and even bears a reputation for cruelty, convinced that leniency only breeds rebellion and that fear is the true cornerstone of rule. Seeking practical results rather than hollow renown, she serves as a sharp, unyielding war-blade under King Derthert, ever ready to clear obstacles for her clan and kingdom.
Background: Silvind was born into the prominent dey Arromanc clan of Vlandia and grew up in the clan's seat of Jaculan. As the daughter of clan matriarch Calatild and Enthem, she was steeped from childhood in the feudal traditions left by "Iron-Arm" Osric. In a political climate where Vlandian barons vie against one another and royal authority wavers, she came to believe early on that her clan's standing must be defended through uncompromising force and statecraft. Rejecting a comfortable noble life, she threw herself into rigorous martial training and showed exceptional talent in tactical command and weapons mastery. Whereas her mother is known for stern fairness, Silvind earned a fearsome reputation across the kingdom for the merciless methods she used in governing the fiefs and leading armies on campaign. Steadfastly loyal to King Derthert and distinguished in many wars, she strives through her iron-fisted rule to ensure that the dey Arromanc clan never falls from power in Vlandia.
